t0029-01.gloss: A pickup record places transport at the gate before the household list was completed.
t0029-01.rival_reading: The same route could have moved field workers or supplies; an early vehicle mark does not identify its purpose.

t0029-02.gloss: A family water warning follows a field crew rinse and leaves the source uncertain.
t0029-02.rival_reading: A containment crew could have rinsed a trailer tank during cleanup; the warning does not establish what caused the danger.
